instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Replace subject dropdown select and Previous/Next buttons in the Solutions component with Subject Small Tabs (Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, LR/English).

2. Under the selected subject tab, add a horizontal scrolling/wrapped row of question number buttons (1, 2, 3... N) with visual indicators for Correct (green), Incorrect (red), and Unattempted (slate).
3. Render ONLY the selected question's question stem and solution step in the solution panel when clicked.
4. Upgrade sitewide navigation tabs, buttons, and surfaces to be bold, colorful, and tactile while maintaining high elegance and readability.

5. Integrate the new JEELIVE.AI logo URL (https://customer-assets-rejwkqb3.emergentagent.net/job_campus-search-debug/artifacts/6a1feb9ab42bd8d4_IMG-20261023-WA8815.jpg) into the top brand header, footer, and login/mobile views.
6. Force light mode background specifically inside question/solution reading surfaces (.exam-light) for optimal PDF diagram and formula clarity.
7. Preserve existing features, exam card identities (JEE Main blood red, BITSAT saffron orange, All India deep blue, COMEDK black), auth, and student metrics.
8. Ensure all new interactive elements (subject tabs, question buttons, solution panel, logo) carry kebab-case data-testid attributes in .js component files.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: This codebase uses JavaScript (.js) files. Provide React guidelines, JSX, and CSS instructions for .js files.
Never use completely transparent backgrounds for dropdown menus or floating headers; use backdrop-blur with semi-opaque surfaces.
Ensure all touch targets on mobile (390px viewport) have minimum 40px height and width.
Maintain high APCA/WCAG AA contrast for text over dark or colorful gradient surfaces.
Ensure all interactive elements carry explicit role and kebab-case data-testid attributes for testing.
